d:
Kashmir ko lekar jammu-kashmir ke purv mukhyamantri faruq abdullah ke die bayan par siyasi hangama mach gaya hai. bijepi ne unke bayan ko 'bharat virodhi' bataya hai. kangres ke netaon ne bhi abdullah ke is bayan ki aalochna ki hai. kaee muslim dharmaguruon ne bhi faruq abdullah ke bayan ki ninda ki hai. neshnal konfrens ke adhyaksh faruq abdullah ne aisa kya kaha? dekhie ye vidiyo.
